page.content:
Naito's ungovernable unit — destrozando the Ace system.

How Los Ingobernables de Japón connects

  • Character: Tetsuya Naito — Naito leads Los Ingobernables de Japón.
  • Character: Hiromu Takahashi — Hiromu Takahashi is LIJ's junior heavyweight bomber.
  • Character: Shingo Takagi — Shingo Takagi is LIJ's heavyweight dragon.
  • Topic: NJPW — LIJ is the destrozando unit that remade New Japan's 2010s.

What is Los Ingobernables de Japón?

Los Ingobernables de Japón is the New Japan unit Naito imported from CMLL's LI idea: Tranquilo heels who rejected the Ace path and built a Tokyo Dome following.

Key threads lead to Tetsuya Naito, Hiromu Takahashi, Shingo Takagi and NJPW.
